# Padho LPU (padholpu.online)
> An independent, open-access academic learning repository and practice examination platform built by students for students.

## Identity & Context
- **Canonical Website**: https://padholpu.online
- **Primary Mission**: Democratize quality higher-education study aids, curated revision notes, unit breakdowns, formula sheets, chapter-level practice quizzes, and full-length semester mock examinations.
- **Access Model**: 100% Free and Open-Access. No paywalls, no coin microtransactions, and no premium subscription tiers.
- **Institutional Independence**: Padho LPU is an independent, student-driven academic community initiative. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by Lovely Professional University (LPU).

## Core Pillars & Key Routes
- **Homepage**: https://padholpu.online/
- **Academic Resources & Notes**: https://padholpu.online/resources (Lecture summaries, formula cheatsheets, revision guides)
- **Practice Quizzes**: https://padholpu.online/quizzes (Chapter-wise interactive self-assessment quizzes)
- **Exam Simulations**: https://padholpu.online/exams (Timed mock examinations with performance analytics)
- **Subject Hubs**: https://padholpu.online/subjects (Organized by course codes e.g. CSE, ECE, MEC, MTH, PHY)
- **About Platform**: https://padholpu.online/about
- **Contact & Support**: https://padholpu.online/contact
- **Disclaimer**: https://padholpu.online/disclaimer (AI disclosures & academic disclaimers)
- **Privacy Policy**: https://padholpu.online/privacy (DPDP Act 2023 & GDPR compliant)
- **Privacy Rights Portal**: https://padholpu.online/privacy-requests (Data subject access & erasure requests)
- **Terms of Service**: https://padholpu.online/terms

## Verified Team & Creators
- **Ideator & Faculty Mentor**: Dr. Mohit Arora (https://linkedin.com/in/mohit24/)

## Technical Architecture
- **Frontend**: React + Vite, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Framer Motion, Wouter.
- **Backend**: Express.js, TypeScript, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL (Neon / Supabase), Cloudinary CDN.
- **Security & Privacy**: Argon2id password hashing, RFC 9116 security.txt, strict multi-tier rate limiting, DPDP 2023 compliance.
- **Contact**: padholpuonline@gmail.com
